schemeName: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme
nodalMinistryName: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
briefDescription: The Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS) provides quality healthcare to eligible families in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Under CMCHIS, cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year is provided on a family floater basis.
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant and family must be permanent residents of Tamil Nadu.
The annual family income must be less than ₹1,20,000 per annum as certified by Revenue authorities.
Members listed in eligible Ration Card / Family Card are covered.
documentsRequired: Income Certificate issued by VAO / Tahsildar
applicationProcess: Visit the designated CMCHIS enrolment centre or District Collectorate with required documents.
